rows.name: Achaemenid Empire
rows.correction: Achaemenid rule ends with Darius III’s death in 330 BCE; Alexander holds these lands from 329 BCE.

rows.name: Macedonian Empire
rows.correction: Relabelled from Ptolemaic Kingdom: these are Alexander’s conquests; Ptolemy ruled Egypt only from 323 BCE.

rows.name: Polyperchon
rows.correction: Polyperchon governs Macedon as regent of Alexander’s empire, so he is listed with it.
